description: IEEE 802.3bt PoE PD front end (ADI DC2583A design): LT4321 ideal-diode bridge with 8 x PSMN075-100MSE, CM choke and SMBJ58A TVS, LT4294 (Class 8) with a PSMN040-100MSE high-side hot-swap FET, T2P power grant over one FOD817AS optocoupler. Rated for continuous 90 W at the PD. No PD current limit. Drawn and parity-checked; not yet bench-proven. No compliance certification claimed.
keywords: PoE PD 802.3bt LT4294 LT4321 ideal bridge

fields.Layout: F.Cu/B.Cu, 130 x 74 mm, FET copper sized for 90 W, 6 mm isolation barrier under the opto (BLOCK.md section 9)
